name: bromodomain containing 3
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: BRD3 encodes bromodomain-containing protein 3. Annotated molecular activities include protein serine/threonine kinase activity and histone reader activity. It participates in transcription elongation-coupled chromatin remodeling and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include NUT carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports rearrangement context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
